#: Regression checks for bounded HTTP input and worker admission.
httpcheck.title: bounded HTTP client input and shutdown
httpcheck.invalidNotDispatched: invalid framing never reaches a route
httpcheck.emptyBody: omitted Content-Length keeps the empty-body contract
httpcheck.leadingZeros: valid decimal leading zeros are accepted
httpcheck.exactLimit: a body at the configured limit is accepted
httpcheck.shortBody: an early body EOF gets a 400
httpcheck.partialBody: a dribbling body gets a JSON 408
httpcheck.deadline: input has an absolute deadline despite incoming bytes
httpcheck.localized: the timeout carries a catalogue message
httpcheck.longGet: GET route execution can outlast both input deadlines
httpcheck.longPost: POST route execution can outlast both input deadlines
httpcheck.repeatedRefusals: successive refusals preserve their JSON response on Windows
httpcheck.boundedDrains: refused sockets also have bounded drain capacity
httpcheck.recovered: requests work after capacity is released
httpcheck.operationStarted: the long operation started before shutdown
httpcheck.shutdownBounded: shutdown does not wait for input or native work
httpcheck.activeClosed: shutdown closes a socket waiting for native work
httpcheck.partialClosed: shutdown closes an incomplete body socket
httpcheck.partialHeadersClosed: shutdown closes an incomplete header socket
httpcheck.operationCompletes: the native operation can finish after shutdown
